headline: How product teams turn behavioral data into daily decisions
deck: A fictional Amplitude Daily brief for demo readers evaluating analytics and experimentation.
body: Product leaders no longer wait for quarterly reviews to understand what changed in their funnels. They compare cohorts, session paths, and retention curves every morning—then ship answers the same day.
This article is seeded content for Phase 0. Later phases will add search, accounts, instrumentation, and experiments without replacing this route.
